note: Poses of the doll, as turns about the MODEL's axes (+X the doll's left, +Y up, +Z forward), in degrees, applied to a bone in its parent's bind frame: q_local = inverse(pBind) * R * pBind * restLocal, where pBind is the parent's bind-pose world rotation and R is Euler XYZ of the numbers. Never author a limb as a local Euler: the limb bones are Blender-style frames (local Y along the bone) and the left and right ones are not mirrored. A positive turn about +X on a limb that hangs down swings it BACKWARD. `hips` is an offset of the root bone in metres, `scales` a bone scale. The numbers are the ones checked on pictures (poses.png); the file is 1.7 m tall, so a page that draws her 0.3 m tall scales the whole thing by 0.176 and these offsets with it.
formula: q_local = inverse(pBind) * R(model axes) * pBind * restLocal

rest.note: the bind pose: an A pose, arms about 35 degrees below horizontal

stand.note: standing on a palm: arms out a little for balance

ride.note: astride a dragon's head, holding on: legs spread, knees bent, arms forward. Feet are stumps: the stirrup reads poorly but is fine at chibi size

scream.note: fists up in front of the chest: the only fist pose that shows. Hands over z 0.6 m clear the front hair

fall.note: falling face down, limbs flailing. Reads as a ball of pink hair with tiny limbs: spread the limbs wide and use the camera

sit.note: on the edge of a frame, shins hanging: swing by animating the two Leg turns between 70 and 100

run.note: run contact pose. Arms are tiny

held.note: dangling from a hand or a beak: arms out, legs limp, head dropped

reach.note: an arm stretched forward and a little up (about 30 degrees above horizontal), the left arm stretched: LeftArm scale y 1.6 with the hand counter-scaled so the mitten stays round, NEVER ForeArm too (they compound). The hand ends beside the head, never above it. This is a reach, not a hang: see notAchievable

puzzle.note: the Selena film (26 Nov 2026): puzzled, the right mitten up at the chin, the left fist on the hip, the head tilted. The hand stays under the hair (see notAchievable)

cower.note: the Selena film: scared, shrinking, both mittens up in front of the mouth and the knees in

startle.note: the Selena film: the start of a fright, arms thrown out wide at the shoulders (not above them), legs apart, leaning back

hop.note: the Selena film: a happy tucked hop off the drone, arms out wide, knees up

notAchievable.name: hang by one hand
notAchievable.tried: LeftArm turned about Z by +100 to +150 degrees (straight up) with the stretch, with and without a Hips roll of 28 degrees either way, seen from the front, the three-quarter and the side
notAchievable.why: head and hair are 59 percent of her height and 82 percent of her vertices: an arm above the shoulder line goes inside the hair mass and the hand is not seen from any angle. A forward and up arm (reach) clears the hair but ends at head height, far from a ledge above her.
notAchievable.instead: Show the hold with the thing she holds: put the edge or the string at socket_hand_L and let her legs dangle (the held pose), or camera from below. The hand is still there for a hit test or a prop.
